name: PlotQA: Reasoning over Scientific Plots
description: PlotQA is a large-scale visual question answering benchmark focused on complex reasoning over scientific plots and charts. It comprises 28 million question-answer pairs ground-truthed on 224,377 synthetic and real-world scientific plots across bar charts, line plots, and dot plots. Questions demand both visual perception and structural mathematical and relational reasoning over tabular plot elements.
